newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NatFoods has small assets under review.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NatFoods has small assets under review.

text.p: National Foods Ltd managing director Max Ould said on Thursday the value of the assets the company had under review, to either sell or merge into existing activities, was in the 'millions of dollars'.

Asked by reporters after the company's annual meeting if the assets were worth around A$100 million, Ould repiled: "They are substantially under A$100 million...probably more in the millions of dollars."
Ould said the assets under review included warehouses owned by the group and distribution businesses that could be contracted out to other groups.
Ould earlier told reporters the company was undertaking a critical review of the company's "lazy assets".
He said the beverage and diary group had no plans to sell its poor performing Sunburst Foods business, which makes juices.
"We in the beverage business and juices are a part of the beverage business, so I would not like to exit any part of the beverage business if we can make money out of it," Ould told reporters.
National Foods chairman Barry Capp earlier described Sunburst profit performance as far from satisfactory.
